description: If \(A\in C\sigma\) and \(\neg A\in D\tau\) for ground substitutions, one admissible generalized inference on \(C,D\), selecting exactly the full pivot fibers in their fresh copies, has a resolvent \(E\) and ground \(\rho\) with \(E\rho=(C\sigma\setminus\{A\})\cup(D\tau\setminus\{\neg A\})\).
